caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the Eval PPL (Evaluation Perplexity) of four different model configurations as a function of the Activated Parameters Ratio (%), which represents the sparsity level applied to the model's components. The x-axis, labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)", ranges from 100% to 25% and is presented on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 25%. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL", ranges from 11.5 to 14.0 and is also on a linear scale, with tick marks appearing at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four distinct lines: the "Transformer" baseline is shown as a dashed red line with circular markers, remaining constant at an Eval PPL of approximately 11.75 across the entire range. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration is represented by a gray dashed line with square markers, starting at an Eval PPL of approximately 11.75 at 100% sparsity and decreasing to approximately 11.65 at 25% sparsity. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is shown as a solid dark blue line with circular markers, beginning at an Eval PPL of approximately 11.75 at 100% sparsity and rising to approximately 12.25 at 25% sparsity. The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is depicted as a solid blue line with cross markers, starting at an Eval PPL of approximately 11.75 at 100% sparsity and increasing to approximately 13.15 at 25% sparsity.
